Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misreported Samuel Arthur Saunder’s death year as 2012 instead of 1912, likely picking a faulty source snippet and ignoring authoritative sources (Wikipedia, RAS) that showed 1912. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Saunder died later, when in fact Stephen De Staebler (2011) died later than Saunder (1912).
